title: Mission Enabling Enforcement Services (MEES) -IRS-CI
agency: TREASURY, DEPARTMENT OF THE > INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE > NORTHEAST REGION
description: The Mission Enabling Enforcement Services (MEES) will provide enterprise data engineering, advanced analytics, secure infrastructure, artificial intelligence, machine learning, investigative support, and platform integration services necessary to enable CI to execute its core criminal investigative mission and meet expanding operational requirements.
